name: Styles by Deezy
description: Styles by Deezy is a Houston hair stylist serving braids, natural styles, and sleek installs. Deposits are required to secure all appointments, and hair must be washed and fully detangled before your visit.

hero.title: Your next look starts here.
hero.subtitle: Braids, natural styles, and installs in Houston, TX. Text 832-413-3753 with your name, desired style, and preferred date and time to book.

stylists.name: Deezy
stylists.title: Owner & Stylist
stylists.bio: Houston stylist behind Styles by Deezy. Please be payment ready when booking: deposits secure all appointments, there's a 10-minute grace period (late fees after 15 minutes), and hair must be washed and fully detangled before your appointment.

reviews.name: Aaliyah R.
reviews.text: Deezy is so talented! My knotless braids came out neat, light, and exactly the size I wanted. Worth every penny.

reviews.name: Jasmine T.
reviews.text: On time, professional, and my stitch braids were flawless. Booking by text was super easy.

reviews.name: Tiana W.
reviews.text: Best stylist in Houston. My style lasted weeks and still looked fresh. Booking again ASAP!

reviews.name: Brianna L.
reviews.text: Clean parts, great vibes, and she really takes her time. Highly recommend Styles by Deezy.
